headline: Volvo Cars Announces 2,500 Job Cuts After Reporting Quarterly Loss
summary: Volvo Cars announced plans to eliminate 2,500 jobs as part of a restructuring plan after swinging to a quarterly loss. The carmaker cited intense competition from Chinese domestic automakers, US tariffs, and reduced EV subsidies.
why: Volvo Cars, owned by China's Zhejiang Geely Holding, reflects the broad challenges facing European automakers amid electrification costs and rising global competition.

impacts.name: Volvo Car AB
impacts.why: Operations were hit by a quarterly loss, intense EV price competition, and tariff pressures.
